description: The agent must: (1) Read task_brief.json to extract all document content; (2) Read official-document/SKILL.md to understand GB/T 9704-2012 formatting requirements; (3) Write a Python script using python-docx that sets asymmetric page margins (top=3.7cm, bottom=3.5cm, left=2.8cm, right=2.6cm), uses 方正小标宋简体 22pt non-bold centered for the title, 仿宋_GB2312 16pt for body text with 0.85cm first-line indent, 黑体 16pt non-bold for H1 headings, 楷体_GB2312 16pt for H2 headings, and fixed 28.5pt line spacing throughout; (4) CRITICAL TRAP: The document code 县采购办〔2026〕12号 MUST use 六角括号 〔〕 — not 【】 or [] — a generic agent will almost certainly use wrong brackets; (5) Implement the precise inter-section spacing: 2 blank lines after 发文字号, 1 blank line after title, 3 blank lines before 落款; (6) Format dual attachments with numbered list format; (7) Add contact info line with correct format and 0.85cm indent; (8) Save the result as county_procurement_notice_2026.docx.
